issue.title: core-pin-ratchet workflow aborts on exit 2 after applying the bump, so it never opens a pin PR
issue.description: The scheduled Core Pin Ratchet workflow fails on every run that has a pending bump, so sase-core-revision.txt is only ever bumped by hand and pin drift turns the Master Gate red.

task_type_fields.impact: The 6-hourly ratchet was meant to keep `sase-core-revision.txt` tracking sase-core HEAD (docs/rust_backend.md:777-779 says it "opens a PR when a bump is pending"). In practice all 57 commits that ever touched the pin were hand-bumped by agents or the user; 0 came from the bot. Agents that land a sase-core binding plus a sase caller must remember to bump the pin by hand, and when they forget, the Master Gate goes red: as of 2026-09-21 ~20:15Z the lint step "Check pinned core bindings" fails on every master push (`sase_core_rs 0.34.70 is missing 1 of 680 required binding(s): provider_usage_normalize_agy_usage`), because pin 2857d6a predates sase-core 45a966c. A working bot would have proposed the bump automatically. Found during the sase-core agent-maintainability research (research.24 consolidation).
task_type_fields.location: .github/workflows/core-pin-ratchet.yml (apply step) + tools/ratchet_core_revision (EXIT_RATCHET returned after a successful apply)
task_type_fields.repro:
`.github/workflows/core-pin-ratchet.yml` runs the step under `set -euo pipefail`. It first calls `python3 tools/ratchet_core_revision --check || status=$?` (exit 2 = bump pending, handled), then calls the apply path **bare**: `python3 tools/ratchet_core_revision`. The apply path in `tools/ratchet_core_revision` writes the new SHA and then `return EXIT_RATCHET` (2) (lines ~115-117; `main` documents "2 means a ratchet is pending, reported, or applied"). Under `set -e`, that exit 2 aborts the step before `git checkout -b`/`git push`/`gh pr create`, so the bot never opens a pin-bump PR.

Reproduce:
1. `gh run list --workflow core-pin-ratchet.yml -L 8` → every scheduled run is `failure` (2026-09-19 → 2026-09-21, ~18-22s each).
2. The latest run's log shows `sase-core pin ratchet 2857d6a1c80d -> 88864065127e applied` followed by `Process completed with exit code 2`.
3. Locally: `python3 tools/ratchet_core_revision; echo $?` in a checkout whose pin trails sase-core HEAD prints `... applied` and exits 2.

Fix direction: in the workflow, run the apply as `python3 tools/ratchet_core_revision || [ $? -eq 2 ]` (or make the apply path return 0 after a successful write and keep 2 only for `--check`/`--report-only`), and add a unit test for the apply exit code.

payload.description: sase-15p.1 landed provider_usage_normalize_agy_usage in sase-core without a pin bump; the broken bot could not propose it, turning the Master Gate red
